literal_meaning: মুখে চুনের কালি পড়া বা লাগা (lime dust falling or sticking on the face)
figurative_meaning_en: To be disgraced or stigmatized; to suffer humiliation or downfall
similar_in_english: Be caught with one's pants down
example_sentences_in_bangla: টাকা চুরি ধরা পড়ায় তার মুখে চুনকালি পড়ল।
পরীক্ষায় নকল করতে গিয়ে ধরা পড়ে তার মুখে চুনকালি লেগেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: When he was caught stealing money, lime dust fell on his face (he was utterly disgraced).
Getting caught cheating in the exam has left lime dust on his face (he has been humiliated).
note: The idiom draws from traditional practices where lime or whitewash was used symbolically to mark shame or disgrace in rural Bengali society.
